s: ^What's the letter say?
^The job seems simple. I'll do it.
^There's more going on here than I'm comfortable with. I'll pass.

discussWithWeft_1a: ^I didn't think such a thing was possible. A branded, receiving a pardon? I've certainly never heard of it happening before now.

s: ^I wouldn't get your hopes up. We have to survive the mine first.
^They're just trying to motivate us to solve their problem without risking any of their guards. We're not getting out of here. Not alive.
^I'm just glad to take any lifeline I'm given.
^If you found it so strange, why did you accept? Even the Director was surprised.

c-0: ^Too true. You're handy in a fight, but I don't expect we will get very far.

s: ^Then why did you accept? Even the Director was surprised.

discussWithWeft_1c: ^*Weft hesitates before speaking, keeping his voice low.* Because, either way our mission ends, it is an escape from this torturous betweenness I've woven for myself.

^The guards use me as an example of the perfect branded, but my usefulness only earns me a calculating hesitation before their abuses begin. Even Tabor would see me dead after I've learned all I can. And the other branded sharpen knives in their minds when they see me approach.

^I did not realize the decisions that earned my bed would also reward me with too much worry to find any rest in it. Even as I reveal this to you I think 'does it matter?' Do they think this is some scheme to drop their guard so I can leave them when the worms are close?

s: ^And all that talk about taking pride in being chosen by the Lovashi? Was that just rubbish?
^I admit, the thought of a betrayal had crossed my mind.
^I can sense the realness of your words. Stick close. We'll get through this together.
^You sold out your friends, strut around like the lord of the camp, and then weep when you're hated for it? You'll not gain sympathy from me.

c-0: ^I had just met you. I knew not if you were friend, foe, or some test of the masters to keep me on my toes. I am still not entirely sure, but if we are to risk death in the mine together, I believe a revelation like this is warranted.
c-1: ^I understand. I am not a fighter, but I will do what I can to earn my keep. By the end of this, you will know you can trust me at with your back.
c-2: ^Truly? I am unsure whether you jest, but I will show you through my actions that I am worthy of such trust.
c-3: ^*Weft shakes his head.* I should have expected such. I won't bother you with these thoughts again.

discussWithWeft_1d: ^Because you are new, you have not yet learned the importance of maintaining your value to the Lovashi. Let us get on with it.

^That's no concern of yours.

^If I find his body, I will let you know.
^I am already risking my life, I'm not going to risk it further by wandering around in the dark.
